mapper.select: SELECT um.company_code, um.user_id, um.user_name, um.dept, dm.dept_name, um.hire_date, um.job_title, job.code_name AS job_title_name, um.position, position.code_name AS position_name, um.tel, um.email FROM tb_user_master um LEFT JOIN tb_dept_master dm ON um.dept = dm.dept_code LEFT JOIN tb_cm_code hire ON um.hire_type = hire.code LEFT JOIN tb_cm_code job ON um.job_title = job.code LEFT JOIN tb_cm_code position ON um.position = position.code LEFT JOIN tb_cm_code ustatus ON um.user_status = ustatus.code AND ustatus.group_code = '0E' ORDER BY user_id DESC
SELECT dept_code, upper_dept_no, dept_name FROM tb_dept_master WHERE upper_dept_no IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dept_code

SELECT um.company_code, um.user_id, um.user_name, um.tel, um.email, um.hire_date, um.hire_type, hire.code_name AS hire_type_name, um.leave_date, um.leave_reason, um.zip_code, um.address, um.dept, dm.dept_name, um.job_title, job.code_name AS job_title_name, um.position, position.code_name AS position_name, um.family_count, um.children_count, um.householder, um.bank_name, um.account_no, um.account_holder, um.salary, um.user_status, ustatus.code_name AS user_status_name, um.user_photo, um.user_file, um.remark FROM tb_user_master um LEFT JOIN tb_dept_master dm ON um.dept = dm.dept_code LEFT JOIN tb_cm_code hire ON um.hire_type = hire.code LEFT JOIN tb_cm_code job ON um.job_title = job.code LEFT JOIN tb_cm_code position ON um.position = position.code LEFT JOIN tb_cm_code ustatus ON um.user_status = ustatus.code AND ustatus.group_code = '0E' WHERE um.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT c.certi_seq, c.company_code, c.user_id, c.certi_name, c.issue_org_name, c.get_date, c.license_no, c.expire_date, c.certi_file, c.remark FROM tb_user_master um LEFT JOIN tb_certification c ON um.user_id = c.user_id WHERE um.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT wex.wex_seq, wex.company_code, wex.user_id, wex.wex_company_name, wex.wex_dept, wex.wex_job_title, wex.wex_hire_date, wex.wex_leave_date, wex.wex_main_duty, wex.wex_salary, wex.remark FROM tb_user_master um LEFT JOIN tb_work_experience wex ON um.user_id = wex.user_id WHERE um.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT uh.ehist_seq, uh.company_code, uh.hist_type, uh.user_id, uh.hist_type, type.code_name AS hist_type_name, uh.apply_date, uh.prev_dept, deptP.dept_name AS prev_dept_name, uh.prev_job_title, jobP.code_name AS prev_job_title_name, uh.new_dept, deptN.dept_name AS new_dept_name, uh.new_job_title, jobN.code_name AS new_job_title_name, uh.dept_change_reason, uh.base_salary, uh.total_salary, uh.pay_type, pay.code_name AS pay_type_name, uh.salary_change_reason FROM tb_user_master um LEFT JOIN tb_user_history uh ON um.user_id = uh.user_id LEFT JOIN tb_cm_code type ON uh.hist_type = type.code LEFT JOIN tb_cm_code jobP ON uh.prev_job_title = jobP.code LEFT JOIN tb_cm_code jobN ON uh.new_job_title = jobN.code LEFT JOIN tb_cm_code pay ON uh.pay_type = pay.code LEFT JOIN tb_dept_master deptP ON uh.prev_dept = deptP.dept_code LEFT JOIN tb_dept_master deptN ON uh.new_dept = deptN.dept_code WHERE um.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT um.company_code, um.user_id, um.user_name, um.dept, dm.dept_name, um.hire_date, um.job_title, job.code_name AS job_title_name, um.position, position.code_name AS position_name, um.tel, um.email FROM tb_user_master um LEFT JOIN tb_dept_master dm ON um.dept = dm.dept_code LEFT JOIN tb_cm_code hire ON um.hire_type = hire.code LEFT JOIN tb_cm_code job ON um.job_title = job.code LEFT JOIN tb_cm_code position ON um.position = position.code LEFT JOIN tb_cm_code ustatus ON um.user_status = ustatus.code AND ustatus.group_code = '0E'
AND um.user_name LIKE '%' || #{keyName} || '%'

SELECT 'EMP' || TO_CHAR(#{hireDate}, 'YYMMDD') || LPAD( NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(user_id, 10, 5))) + 1, 1), 5, '0' ) AS user_id FROM tb_user_master WHERE TRUNC(hire_date) = TRUNC(#{hireDate})
INSERT INTO tb_user_master ( company_code, user_id, user_name, tel, email, hire_date, hire_type, leave_date, leave_reason, zip_code, address, dept, job_title, position, family_count, children_count, householder, bank_name, account_no, account_holder, salary, user_status, user_photo, user_file, remark, created_by, create_date) VALUES( '0000', #{userId}, #{userName}, #{tel}, #{email}, #{hireDate}, #{hireType}, #{leaveDate}, #{leaveReason}, #{zipCode}, #{address}, #{dept}, #{jobTitle}, #{position}, #{familyCount}, #{childrenCount}, #{householder}, #{bankName}, #{accountNo}, #{accountHolder}, #{salary}, #{userStatus}, #{userPhoto}, #{userFile}, #{remark}, #{createdBy}, SYSDATE )
